title: Crestline Fleet Account Route Credit for Regular Mobile Service
content:
A Crestline Fleet Account that uses mobile service regularly earns a route credit, taken off the fee a contested mobile service visit owes.

| Mobile service visit fee invoices on the account dated less than twelve whole months before today | Route credit |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 5.00 |
| 3 to 5 | 2.50 |
| fewer than 3 | nothing |

Every mobile service call invoice posted to the account with an invoice date less than twelve whole months before today is counted, the contested visit fee invoice included when its date falls in that period.

## Boundaries

| Visit fee invoices counted | Route credit |
|---|---|
| 2 | none |
| 3 | 2.50 |
| 5 | 2.50 |
| 6 | 5.00 |

The fee owed is never below 0.00, the floor being applied once after every addition and credit, not to each amount in turn.
